item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00404","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C11","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.89,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 plausibly supplied a concrete template for acknowledging an advisory body's completed report: opening with the President's favorable reaction to the report, explaining its policy significance, indicating future governmental consideration or use, and closing with personal appreciation to the chairman and pride in the group's contribution. Several closely parallel phrases reinforce the shared structure. C11 is also similar in its retrospective praise of an advisory member's concrete accomplishments and public service, while C21 parallels the response-to-report form, but neither matches the child's full drafting sequence as closely as C05.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I have read with great interest and appreciation your final report as Chairman of the President's Task Force on Latin America.","parent_excerpt":"I am impressed by the report of the Advisory Board on International Development.","explanation":"Both open by registering the President's favorable assessment of a completed advisory-group report addressed to its chairman."},{"child_excerpt":"This record is one of which you and your fellow task force members should be proud.","parent_excerpt":"You, your Board, and your staff can take great pride in the contribution which you have made","explanation":"Distinctively parallel language tells the chairman and fellow members to take pride in the group's contribution."},{"child_excerpt":"I intend to give careful and serious study to your recommendations for future policy","parent_excerpt":"I am also directing the Government agencies concerned to give your report their immediate consideration.","explanation":"Both move from praise to prospective governmental consideration and use of the report."},{"child_excerpt":"Let me extend to you my warmest expressions of deep personal gratitude for the time, energy and talent you have devoted to the work of the task force","parent_excerpt":"Please accept my deepest personal appreciation for the task which your Board has accomplished and the leadership which you have contributed to it.","explanation":"The closings share unusually close gratitude language directed personally to the chairman for the advisory body's completed task and his leadership."}]}
